NEW V3 surface.

findings.description: Reentrancy via promo-token transfer in a loop. batchClaim() calls _tryTransfer(promoToken, staker, pending) (raw .call at L459/L816-818) and updates per-staker promo accounting; a malicious/hooked promoToken could re-enter batchClaim or other entrypoints during the loop. promoToken is externally supplied to startPromotion (arbitrary address) -- elevates the reentrancy surface. NEW V3 surface; review with SA-016 (raw call) and SA-018 (calls-loop).

Cross-contract reentrancy across V2->V3 boundary during a batch; the withdraw leg mints phUSD rewards to user before the V3 stake completes. NEW V3-migration surface.

findings.description: Same reentrancy pattern (phUSD.mint via _claimRewards before state write) in retired V1 PhlimboEA.stake(308)/withdraw(351)/claim(391) and _claimRewards(451). V1 retired 2026-06-08 (users migrated to V2) -- lower priority, included for completeness. Also flagged reentrancy-events (Slither) on the same functions.

Dangerous strict equality on token balance delta. startPromotion (L349: IERC20(token).balanceOf(this) - balanceBefore == amount) and topUpPromotion (L377: promoToken.balanceOf(this) - balanceBefore == amount) require an EXACT balance delta. A fee-on-transfer / rebasing / donation-affected promo token (promoToken is an arbitrary externally-supplied address) makes the delta != amount and bricks promotion funding, or an unsolicited transfer front-run breaks the invariant. NEW V3 surface.

Dangerous strict equality on contract balances. settleDebt requires usdc.balanceOf(this)==totalUSDC and phUSD.balanceOf(this)==totalPHUSD_deposited (L155-193); migrateDeposits requires phUSD.balanceOf(this)==totalPHUSD_deposited (L203). Any dust/donation/rounding making the balance not exactly equal reverts the whole settlement/migration (griefable DoS via 1-wei donation).

Multiplication after division (precision loss) in reward math. PhlimboV3._updatePool (L715, both stable reward: potentialReward = (rewardPerSecond*timeElapsed)/PRECISION, and promo: potentialPromo = (promoRewardPerSecond*timeElapsed)/PRECISION), pendingStable (L855), pendingPromo (L876). Ordering div-before-mul can truncate accrued rewards; matters for the Linear-Depletion model. NEW V3 promo path (promoRewardPerSecond) is unaudited. Verify rounding direction favors the protocol.

Multiplication after division in reward math: PhlimboV2._updatePool (L442) and pendingStable (L542). Mirror of SA-014 on V1 Phlimbo._updatePool (L406) / pendingStable (L526). Inherited reward-accrual precision concern.

Raw low-level token call in _tryTransfer (L816-820: (callSuccess,returndata)=address(token).call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transfer,(to,amount)))). This is an intentional try-transfer wrapper (return value IS captured in callSuccess) used by batchClaim to avoid a single bad promo recipient bricking the batch. Flag retained for review: confirm callSuccess/returndata are correctly interpreted for non-standard tokens and that a silently-failing transfer does not zero the staker's promo accounting. NEW V3 surface.

Ignored return value of EnumerableSet ops: _stakers.add(user) (L613) and _stakers.remove(user) (L659). Typically benign (idempotent set membership), but confirm double-add / missing-remove cannot desync the _stakers enumeration used by batchClaim iteration. NEW V3 surface.

Ignored tuple return in migrate(): (amount,,) = phlimboV2.userInfo(user) (L160) discards other userInfo fields (e.g. rewardDebt / paused flags). Confirm migrating only 'amount' without carrying the rest cannot drop pending rewards or paused-withdraw state across the V2->V3 boundary. NEW V3-migration surface.

External calls inside the batch loop (userInfo, balanceOf x4, phlimboV2.withdraw, phlimboV3.stake -- L160-182). Unbounded batch of cross-contract calls risks gas-limit DoS on large batches and compounds the reentrancy surface (SA-005). Same pattern in MigratorV1V2.settleDebt (L181 phUSD.mint) and migrateDeposits (L227 phlimboV2.stake), and PhlimboV3._tryTransfer (L816). Verify batch-size bounds.

nonReentrant is NOT the first modifier on PhlimboV3.stake(584)/withdraw(629)/claim(679) and PhlimboV2.stake(323)/withdraw(363)/claim(407). A preceding modifier (e.g. whenNotPaused / access check) executes before the reentrancy lock engages. If any preceding modifier makes an external call or reads reentrancy-sensitive state, the guard is bypassable for that window. Directly relevant to the reentrancy findings SA-001..SA-003/SA-008..SA-010. NEW V3 surface (+ inherited V2).
findings.rawCheck: nonReentrant is Not the First Modifier

findings.description: Uninitialized locals pendingPhUSDAmount (L688) and pendingRewardAmount (L689) in PhlimboV3.claim. Likely assigned on all branches before use (benign default-0), but confirm no early-return / conditional path uses them at default zero and silently skips a reward payout. NEW V3 surface. Same pattern in PhlimboV2.claim (L416-417).

Uninitialized locals sumUSDC (L121), sumDep (L122), sumPending (L123) in seedObligations -- accumulators that should start at 0. Benign if only ever summed, but confirm they are not read before the summation loop and that the totals they feed (used in the strict-equality settlement, SA-013) are computed over the full input arrays.

block.timestamp drives reward accrual across V3: _updatePool (L716 block.timestamp<=lastRewardTime), pendingStable (L855), pendingPhUSD (L839), pendingPromo (L876: promoToken!=0 && block.timestamp>lastRewardTime), _claimRewards (L774), withdraw (L629), pauseWithdraw (L537). KEPT (not dropped as informational): the Linear-Depletion model computes emissions as a function of elapsed time, so timestamp logic is load-bearing. Review for accrual gaps/overlaps at lastRewardTime boundaries, and the NEW promo accrual window. Let dedup/severity decide.

block.timestamp drives reward accrual across V2: _updatePool (L443), pendingStable (L542), pendingPhUSD (L526), _claimRewards (L486), withdraw (L363), pauseWithdraw (L280). Inherited time-driven accrual; same review rationale as SA-023.

block.timestamp drives reward accrual across retired V1: _updatePool (L407), pendingStable (L526), pendingPhUSD (L505), _claimRewards (L462), withdraw (L351), pauseWithdraw (L258). V1 retired -- lowest priority; kept for time-driven-model completeness.

Secondary strict-equality instance (grouped with SA-012): topUpPromotion (L377) requires promoToken.balanceOf(this)-balanceBefore==amount. Retained separately to flag the top-up path distinctly from initial startPromotion funding. NEW V3 surface.

Aderyn 'state change after external call' on V3 promo admin: startPromotion (L349/L351) and topUpPromotion (L377/L379) do promoToken.transferFrom then write promotion state (promoRewardPerSecond, windows). With an arbitrary externally-supplied promoToken, a re-entering token could observe/perturb half-set promotion state. Owner-invoked (Law-3: assess as footgun if a non-obvious consequence). NEW V3 surface; pairs with SA-012.
